responsibility: Acts as the core shared machine-description header for the M32C port, defining canonical register-number constants, unspec codes, flag attributes, mode iterators/attributes, and a few baseline patterns such as nop. Other .md files rely on these definitions to share register identities, pseudo-op encodings, flag semantics, and mode abstractions across the target’s split instruction descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Core machine-description file for the shared m32c stem: unlike m32c.cc or m32c.h, it is written in GCC MD form and defines target RTL constants, attributes, mode iterators, and baseline instruction patterns that other instruction description files can reference, not C/C++ hook code or option specs.
